messages:
anya: Heads up — we need a partner ops review kit for next week’s partner summit. Can we lock MDF asks, tier updates, and a short marketplace blurb?
kevin: I have a preliminary MDF calc. Rough split: marketplace credits, HW co-fund, SI enablement. Want a quick table? :+1:
elena: Please include legal checklist — we can’t promise co-funding without the SI contract template. I’ll ping legal now.
kevin: ```
Line Item | Amount
Marketplace credits | $400,000
Hardware co-fund | $150,000
SI enablement | $75,000
Contingency (10%) | $62,500
Total | $687,500
```
liam: For the joint announcement, we should only promise Gold SLA for Dedicated customers. Bronze/Silver ok for marketplace listings. Also the hardware quantization pilot remains beta — call that out.
tom: Marketing wants a 1-liner and a short benefits bullet for the marketplace card. I’ll draft one and post in #marketing; can someone review before Friday? :eyes:
anya: Ops needs expected latency numbers and recommended benchmark models for the scorecard update. Kevin — can you add those to the kit?
kevin: Adding a short note on scorecard impact: MDF tiers affect marketplace placement and co-sell credits. Dropping numbers into the shared doc now.
qbr-bot: Reminder: Partner Review package due in 48h — upload to /shared/partner-reviews or run `/partner-kit upload`
anya: Thanks. I’ll compile everything and run a quick internal review tomorrow AM. Tagging @elena @kevin @liam for final sign-off.
kevin: I’ll sign off after legal greenlight.
elena: On it — should have contract checklist by EOD.
